text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy ran hard in the Takarazuka 
Kinen. However, the racing broadcast was 
completely dominated by the "Strongest 
Great King" who achieved greatness in the 
Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy didn't seem discouraged, 
though... Setting her next goal on the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn), she vowed to steadily 
build up her strength.
